clips.label: CFG 0.8
clips.details:
ComfyUI CFG 0.8

Same brass-snail opening and intermediate descriptions: shell with buildings → hollow spiral pavilion → canyon city. CFG is the only changed sampling setting. The negative branch remains zeroed conditioning, not an encoded empty prompt.

Krea Turbo, three Euler intervals, noise 0.40 → 0.78 → 0.64. Every painting starts from the warped previous painting. Bounded Lanczos motion, new painting every 0.5s, RIFE 4.25 between paintings.

6.5 seconds at 24 fps; 13 paintings. All four variants rendered on the same RTX 4090 session.

Assistant painting review: 1.3 and 1.6 open the shell into architecture earlier, with more detailed cities. Higher CFG also makes larger repaint changes. This is a single-scene comparison; smoother animation is not established. CFG 1.0 remains the default pending your review.
